---
title: "Candidates behind each bin"
---

Choose a PAC and a score bin to see the candidates who received its direct contributions.
Sort by clicking a column heading, or type in the search box.

```{python}
import sys; sys.path.insert(0, ".")
import pandas as pd
from pals.names import display_name
from pals_site import BINS, load

t = load()["totals"].copy()
t["candidate"] = t["candidate_name"].map(display_name)
t["party"] = t["party"].fillna("")
keys = ["pac", "candidate_id", "candidate", "party", "state", "office", "score_bin", "match_method"]
t["score"] = t["score"].astype(float)
by_cycle = t.pivot_table(index=keys, columns="cycle", values="dollars", aggfunc="sum", fill_value=0).reset_index()
by_cycle.columns = [str(c) for c in by_cycle.columns]
scores = t.groupby("candidate_id", as_index=False)["score"].first()
wide = by_cycle.merge(scores, on="candidate_id", how="left")
for c in ("2024", "2026"):
    if c not in wide:
        wide[c] = 0.0
wide["total"] = wide["2024"] + wide["2026"]
import json
records = json.loads(wide.round(2).to_json(orient="records"))  # to_json writes NaN as null
ojs_define(rows=records, bins=BINS, pacs=sorted(t["pac"].unique().tolist() + ["Anthropic"]))
```

```{ojs}
rowsData = rows
viewof pacSel = Inputs.select([...new Set(pacs)], {label: "PAC", value: "Google"})
viewof binSel = Inputs.select(["All bins", ...bins], {label: "HRC score bin", value: "All bins"})
```

```{ojs}
filtered = rowsData.filter(d => d.pac === pacSel && (binSel === "All bins" || d.score_bin === binSel))
viewof found = Inputs.search(filtered, {placeholder: "Search candidates"})
```

```{ojs}
filtered.length === 0
  ? html`<p class="note-box">No direct candidate contributions from ${pacSel} in this bin.</p>`
  : Inputs.table(found, {
      columns: ["candidate", "party", "state", "office", "score", "score_bin", "2024", "2026", "total"],
      header: {candidate: "Candidate", party: "Party", state: "State", office: "Office", score: "HRC score",
               score_bin: "Bin", "2024": "2024 cycle", "2026": "2026 cycle", total: "Total"},
      format: {"2024": d => d3.format("$,.0f")(d), "2026": d => d3.format("$,.0f")(d),
               total: d => d3.format("$,.0f")(d), score: d => d == null ? "n/a" : d},
      sort: "total", reverse: true, rows: 25
    })
```

Dollars are net of refunds and voided contributions. *HRC score* is the 118th Congress score of the matched
scorecard entry; candidates with no match or no score are in *No score*.
